explanations.8: pointer-events: none means clicks and touches pass right through this element to whatever is behind it, as if it's invisible to user interaction.
explanations.17: 100vw means the full width of the viewport (the browser window), so the animation moves the element all the way across the screen.
explanations.21: prefers-reduced-motion is a user's accessibility setting that tells websites to avoid animations for people who get dizzy or distracted by motion.
